entries.name: trend_line
entries.note: 2 anchors. Add with chart.addDrawing({ type, anchors }); anchors are { time, price } with time in ms, not seconds.

entries.name: arrow
entries.note: 2 anchors: a line with an arrow head.

entries.name: arrow_marker
entries.note: 2 anchors. TradeCanvas has one arrow tool for the line arrow and the thick arrow marker.

entries.name: extended
entries.note: 2 anchors; the line runs past both.

entries.name: parallel_channel
entries.note: 3 anchors: the two ends of the first line, then a point on the parallel one.

entries.name: regression_trend
entries.note: 2 anchors: the first and last bar of the fit. Named regressionChannel.

entries.name: flat_bottom
entries.note: 3 anchors. One tool for a flat top or a flat bottom.

entries.name: anchored_vwap
entries.note: 1 anchor: the bar the VWAP starts from.

entries.name: fib_retracement
entries.note: 2 anchors. Its own settings (levels and the like) go through chart.setDrawingOptions(id, ...); list them with chart.getDrawingOptionDefs('fibRetracement').

entries.name: fib_trend_time
entries.note: No trend-based Fib time tool. Closest: fibTimeZones (2 anchors) or fibExtension for the 3-point measure.

entries.name: inside_pitchfork
entries.note: No inside pitchfork. Closest: pitchfork or schiffPitchfork (3 anchors).

entries.name: gannbox_fixed
entries.note: No fixed-ratio Gann square. Closest: gannSquare (2 anchors).

entries.name: xabcd_pattern
entries.note: 5 anchors: X, A, B, C, D.

entries.name: triangle_pattern
entries.note: No triangle chart pattern tool. Closest: abcdPattern (4 anchors) or the triangle shape (3 anchors).

entries.name: 3divers_pattern
entries.note: TradeCanvas takes 6 anchors; check how many points your saved shape has and drop or merge the extra.

entries.name: elliott_impulse_wave
entries.note: 6 anchors: the start and waves 1 to 5.

entries.name: elliott_correction
entries.note: 4 anchors: the start, A, B, C.

entries.name: elliott_triangle_wave
entries.note: 6 anchors: the start, A to E.

entries.name: elliott_double_combo
entries.note: 4 anchors: the start, W, X, Y.

entries.name: elliott_triple_combo
entries.note: 6 anchors: the start, W, X, Y, X, Z.

entries.name: long_position
entries.note: 2 anchors: entry, then stop. Long or short follows from the stop being below or above the entry; target from the rewardRatio option.

entries.name: short_position
entries.note: Same tool as long_position: put the stop anchor above the entry for a short.

entries.name: ghost_feed
entries.note: No ghost feed tool. Closest: barsPattern (copies a run of bars, 3 anchors) or forecast.

entries.name: fixed_range_volume_profile
entries.note: 2 anchors: the first and last bar of the range. Named volumeProfileRange.

entries.name: circle
entries.note: 2 anchors: centre, then a point on the edge.

entries.name: double_curve
entries.note: No double curve. Closest: curve (3 anchors), or two curves.

entries.name: brush
entries.note: A freehand stroke; its points are its anchors.

entries.name: highlighter
entries.note: A freehand stroke; its points are its anchors.

entries.name: text
entries.note: 1 anchor. The words go in style.text (addDrawing({ type: 'text', anchors, style: { text } })), not in overrides.

entries.name: callout
entries.note: 2 anchors: the point, then the box.

entries.name: comment
entries.note: No comment tool. Closest: balloon or note (1 anchor).

entries.name: price_note
entries.note: No price note. Closest: priceLabel (1 anchor) or callout (2 anchors).

entries.name: icon
entries.note: 1 anchor. Icons come from TradeCanvas's own icon set, so icon codes do not carry over.

entries.name: emoji
entries.note: No emoji tool. Closest: icon (1 anchor) from the built-in icon set.

entries.name: sticker
entries.note: No sticker tool. Closest: icon (1 anchor).

entries.name: table
entries.note: No table drawing. Closest: note or a status bar item of your own (widget.addStatusBarItem).

entries.name: cursor
entries.note: Not a drawing: ends drawing mode.

entries.name: dot
entries.note: A pointer look, not a drawing.

entries.name: arrow_cursor
entries.note: A pointer look, not a drawing.

entries.name: zoom
entries.note: A mode, not a drawing: drag a box to zoom into.
